strain_or_origin_as_printed: fazenda Santo Antônio, Rio Preto da Eva, AM
rearing_unit_as_printed: tanques-rede com 1 m3 de área útil e malha de 20 mm entrenós
feed_as_printed: ração comercial extrusada com 36% de PB
feeding_regime_as_printed: até a saciedade aparente três vezes por dia, seis dias por semana
water_system_as_printed: açude de 6 ha abastecido por água da chuva
water_context_as_printed: Açude (p2): O2 7,3±0,8 mg/L, temperatura 29,7±0,5 oC, pH 6,7±0,3, dureza 3,6±0,6, alcalinidade 5,6±1,9, amônia total 1,2±0,4 mg/L; amônia fora dos tanques-rede 1,2 mg/L (p3)
uniform_management: Same extruded 36% PB feed and feeding regime in all cages; inner 5 mm multifilament lining; biometry at 30 and 60 days under 100 mg/L benzocaine; blood from 5 fish per cage at 30 and 60 days. The açude also held tambaqui and matrinxã for sport fishing.
design_notes: Completely randomised, 4 densities (200, 300, 400, 500 peixes/m3), 3 replicates; ANOVA and Tukey 5%.
source_inconsistency: Abstract p1: water parameters 'avaliados a cada sete dias'; methods p2: O2 and temperature 'seis vezes por semana'.
notes: Stocking density is the treatment (200, 300, 400, 500 peixes/m3, p2), carried on records. Methods p2 prints GP as 'peso inicial - peso final'.

location: Centro de Referência de Aqüicultura do Vale do São Francisco (Ceraqua-SF), Porto Real do Colégio/AL
life_stage_as_printed: alevinos de tilápia tailandesa A e B (machos revertidos)
initial_size_as_printed: peso médio inicial ao redor de 20 g
rearing_unit_as_printed: tanques de alvenaria tipo “raceway” de 2 m3 de volume útil
stocking_density_as_printed: densidade inicial de estocagem de 100 peixes/m3
feed_as_printed: ração extrusada comercial ... com teores de proteína bruta de 40, 36 e 32%
feeding_regime_as_printed: com base no percentual da biomassa ... duas vezes ao dia (09:00 e 14:00h)
water_system_as_printed: intensivo de águas claras ... com controle da taxa de renovação de água
water_context_as_printed: Temperature, dissolved oxygen and ammonia said to be within adequate limits for tilapia; per-strain values in Tabela 2.
uniform_management: Same extruded commercial feed in every tank, twice a day as a share of biomass, crude protein stepped 40, 36 and 32% with growth; biometry every 20 days to adjust the ration; inflow raised with biomass; tanks covered with anti-bird nets; water quality measured weekly (temperature and oxygen with a digital oximeter, total ammonia with a digital photocolorimeter).
design_notes: Inteiramente casualizado, three treatments (Tailandesa A, Tailandesa B, GIFT), five replicates; data processed in SPSS 15.0.
notes: Strain is the treatment. TA and TB from regional producers in Sergipe and Alagoas; GIFT F1 'procederam do Ceraqua-SF' (p2), abstract p1 says 'proveniente do sul do país (Maringá, PR)'. Life stage printed only for TA and TB. Affiliation null: Ceraqua-SF is the site; acknowledgements p3 thank its team for 'manutenção do experimento'. Trial dates not printed; p2 says GIFT was introduced in 2008.

location: Laboratório de Piscicultura, da Universidade Federal de Santa Maria, RS
strain_or_origin_as_printed: Estação Experimental de Piscicultura, da Universidade Regional Integrada do Alto Uruguai e das Missões
feed_as_printed: ração comercial extrusada com 28% de proteína bruta
feeding_regime_as_printed: à razão de 3% da biomassa por dia
water_system_as_printed: não possuía renovação de água, porém era provido de aeração mecânica (aerador de pás)
water_context_as_printed: Cages in an earthen pond of 0,1 ha and 1,50 m depth (p2). Whole-trial means (p3): temperature 22,04±0,46ºC (manhã) and 23,12±0,75ºC (tarde); dissolved oxygen 7,22±0,11 and 9,24±0,34 mg L-1; alkalinity 34,5±1,04 and hardness 56,0±18,47 mg L-1 de CaCO3; transparency 19,33±2,33 cm; pH 7,01±0,11
uniform_management: Same extruded commercial feed (28% PB) at 3% of biomass a day for all units, given in perimeter feeders of shade cloth; seven days of adaptation; biometry every 30 days with ration adjusted 15 days later; 24 h fasting and eugenol anaesthesia (50 mg L-1) at the end
design_notes: Completely randomized, 2x2 factorial: density 50 or 150 peixes m-3 (2,8 and 8,7 kg m-3) x feeding once (18 h) or twice a day (50% at 08 h, rest at 18 h); 'quatro tratamentos e três repetições'; Duncan at 5%
notes: Cages printed as '1 m-3' (sic, p2) in an earthen pond of 0,1 ha and 1,50 m depth; site at 95 m, 29º43'S, 53º42'W (p2). Density is the treatment (50 and 150 peixes m-3, 'equivalentes a 2,8 e 8,7 kg m-3', p2), so stocking_density_as_printed is null; feeding frequency is the treatment, so feeding_regime holds only the uniform ration. Two fish per cage for blood and two for fillet composition (p3).
